backend/main.mo: Main canister implementing access control, user profiles, image handling, services, contact info, themes, and storage mixin integration.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to updated types, adding new image type support and transforming stored records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requests to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries describing all major frontend components, hooks, and styling files.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading the main module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component composing the site layout, applying background theme settings, and handling profile setup.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin interface for managing contact info, services, store services, background theme settings, and photo background configuration.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: Displays contact info with loading skeletons, decorative layout, and customer photo uploader integration.
frontend/src/components/CustomerPhotoUpl: Handles image selection, validation, processing, preview generation, and upload with progress tracking.
Provides gallery and hero image upload, processing, editing, and admin description management.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders footer with brand info, static contact details, and social media links.
frontend/src/components/GalleryDisplay.t: Shows gallery images with admin editing, description updates, and navigation to gallery management.
frontend/src/components/GalleryManagemen: Admin UI for uploading, editing, replacing, and deleting gallery images with aspect‑ratio processing and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header with scroll effects, mobile menu, and gallery page toggle.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero banner section displaying the latest hero image with admin editing access.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerEditor: Modal editor allowing admins to upload and process hero banner images with aspect ratios.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login, logout, and UI state.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Dialog prompting users to enter and save their name and phone number on first setup.
frontend/src/components/ServicesWithPric: Admin interface for creating, editing, deleting, and managing service listings with images and pricing.
frontend/src/components/SharePhotoBackgr: UI component for selecting, processing, previewing, uploading, and removing a user's share photo background image with aspect ratio, resolution, and fit controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, status, and authentication actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, images, admin status, and related backend data.
frontend/src/hooks/useSharePhotoBackgrou: Hook that stores and updates the background fit mode ('cover' or 'contain') using localStorage.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus extensive CSS variables defining color themes, gradients, and dark mode tokens.
frontend/src/lib/imageProcessor.ts: Utility for resizing, cropping, and compressing images based on chosen aspect ratios, resolutions, and quality settings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean parameters from hash-based URLs. Provides helpers for extracting, storing, retrieving, and clearing values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations. Extends theme tokens and enables dark mode via class.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current feature set and pending requests related to customizable photo uploads in the Share Your Photo section. Tracks schema versions, requirements, and project metadata.
